intro: I make my mixed reality works with these tools, from the first drawing to the link that opens on your phone.

steps.title: Draw
steps.note: Each work starts as a drawing or a painting. Some of those become the image targets a phone tracks.

tools.name: Procreate
tools.text: I sketch, draw line work and test colour in Procreate before a piece goes to paint or to 3D.

tools.name: Adobe Creative Cloud
tools.text: Photoshop and Illustrator prepare my image targets, textures and print files. After Effects and Premiere Pro cut the videos that show each work.

steps.title: Model
steps.note: The drawing becomes a sculpture with depth, light and motion.

tools.name: Blender
tools.text: I model, rig, animate and bake light in Blender, then cut each model down until it loads fast on a phone.

tools.name: Adobe Substance 3D
tools.text: I paint the surfaces in Substance 3D, so each model carries its colour and grain into the browser.

steps.title: Code
steps.note: I write the scene, the tracking and the page that holds each work.

tools.name: Visual Studio Code
tools.text: Every scene, build and page on this site was written and tested in VS Code.

tools.name: Claude
tools.text: I built this site with Claude, working from my own 3D files and what I know HTML, CSS and JavaScript can do. I keep sacred knowledge out of it, and it writes no Anishinaabemowin.

tools.name: JavaScript
tools.text: Every work here runs on JavaScript: the 3D scenes, the AR hooks, the floating sculptures and this site.

tools.name: HTML
tools.text: Each work is a web page first. HTML holds the scene, the splash screen and the buttons.

tools.name: CSS
tools.text: CSS sets the look of the site: the orange-red ground, the type and the cursor.

tools.name: Python
tools.text: I script Blender and batch the model work in Python: exports, texture packing and fixing normal maps.

steps.title: Run
steps.note: What the works run on, in a phone's camera or on a gallery wall.

tools.name: 8th Wall
tools.text: The open source 8th Wall engine tracks the image or the ground in every AR work here. I am moving my works off 8th Wall's hosted platform and hosting them here myself.

tools.name: three.js
tools.text: The 3D views, the Aabijijiwan viewer and the sculptures floating behind this page are drawn with three.js.

tools.name: A-Frame
tools.text: Many of the image target works are A-Frame scenes, built on three.js and run by the 8th Wall engine.

tools.name: Touch­Designer
tools.text: Projection installations run live in TouchDesigner, reading the people in front of the wall through a depth sensor.

steps.title: Ship
steps.note: How a work gets from my desk to your phone.

tools.name: GitHub
tools.text: This site and every build on it live in one GitHub repository. Each change is saved there before it goes live.

tools.name: AWS Amplify
tools.text: Amplify rebuilds the site from GitHub on every change and serves it at xr.noodin.studio.
